# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Sunday, November 8, 2026

Morning edition for Sunday, 8 November 2026 (IST). Covers 6–7 Nov and overnight. Diwali Muhurat trading runs on NSE and BSE this afternoon (2:20–3:30 PM IST); the last full session was Friday, 6 Nov.

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### Muhurat trading today after the Nifty's best week in this run: +8.58%
NSE's circular confirms a special Diwali Muhurat session on Sunday, 8 Nov, with continuous trading from 14:20 to 15:30 IST, and every trade carries settlement obligations. The session follows a week in which the Nifty 50 rose 8.58% (23,053.10 on 30 Oct to 25,030.35 on 6 Nov) and Nifty Financial Services rose 10.41% (24,712.20 to 27,283.95), per NSE index close files.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the session is the last equity print before the scheduled Tranche I NCD allotment, and a financials index up 10% in a week forms the backdrop for the NCD listing and for comparisons with listed gold lenders.
Source: [NSE circular 149/2026](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/CMTR76941.pdf)

### Update: Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD: allotment checkpoint is Monday
Nothing new since the 5 Nov close. Chittorgarh's page this morning still shows final bids of 2.67x at 17:00 IST on 5 Nov and no basis-of-allotment data. The 7 Nov edition carried allotment on 9 Nov and BSE listing on 10 Nov from the same page.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the allotted size against the ₹500 crore ceiling is due to be known on Monday; the listing print on Tuesday sets the secondary-market reference for the rest of the ₹4,000 crore shelf.
Source: [Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

### ICRA finalises Muthoot Fincorp's Delta 3.0 PTC ratings; Delta 5 gets provisional AA+(SO)
On 6 Nov ICRA confirmed as final its ratings on PTCs issued by Delta 3.0, backed by Muthoot Fincorp's unsecured QR code-based merchant loan receivables. On 4 Nov it assigned provisional [ICRA]AA+(SO) to PTC Series A1 and provisional [ICRA]AA-(SO) to the equity PTC of Delta 5, backed by a similar merchant-loan pool.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: another Delta transaction extends securitisation funding for the unsecured QR merchant-loan book; the Delta 5 ratings remain provisional until confirmed.
Source: [ICRA — Delta 3.0 final](https://www.icra.in/Rationale/ShowRationaleReport?Id=146789)

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

### Week in review: gold-loan peers lead a sharp financials rally
From the 30 Oct close to the 6 Nov close on NSE, Muthoot Finance rose 19.11% to ₹2,869.00, IIFL Finance 18.59% to ₹625.75, Shriram Finance 16.76% to ₹961.15, Bajaj Finance 15.83% to ₹1,087.75, Muthoot Microfin 14.12% to ₹153.92 and Manappuram 12.60% to ₹325.40. All six beat the Nifty 50's 8.58% weekly gain.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: listed gold lenders re-rated sharply in a single week despite Muthoot Finance's Q2 Stage 3 increase; peer valuations are the comparison set for Muthoot Fincorp's proposed ₹3,000 crore IPO.
Source: [NSE bhavcopy 6 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_06112026.csv)

### Spot gold slips 0.3% on Friday but posts its best week since August
Reuters, via Economic Times, reported spot gold down 0.3% at $4,074.36 an ounce at 18:54 GMT on 6 Nov after stronger-than-expected US payrolls, but up 5.2% for the week, its best week since August. Gold had touched a one-year low of $3,869.85 on 30 Oct.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a 5% weekly rebound in dollar gold raises collateral values for gold lenders, though IBJA's 999 rate fell 1.86% on 6 Nov and AGLOC's 7–9 Nov ceilings reflect that lower Friday rate.
Source: [Economic Times / Reuters](https://m.economictimes.com/markets/commodities/news/gold-drops-as-strong-us-payrolls-boost-dollar-yields/amp_articleshow/135626183.cms)

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

### RBI grants NBFC registration to MobiKwik's lending subsidiary
One MobiKwik Systems told NSE on 6 Nov that RBI has issued a Certificate of Registration to its wholly owned subsidiary MobiKwik Financial Services Pvt Ltd to operate as an NBFC.
Source: [NSE filing](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/MOBIKWIK_06112026141941_Intimation_about_granting_of_NBFC_License.pdf)

### No new NBFC circular from RBI, SEBI, IBBI or NHB since Friday
RBI's notifications feed has nothing after the 5 Nov cyber-resilience Master Directions for payment system operators, and its press releases end with routine 6 Nov items (a 4-day VRR auction for 9 Nov, a T-bill auction, and the FLA census). SEBI's newest circular is still from 5 Nov. The IBBI site shows a last update of 31 Oct, and NHB's newest notice is dated 4 Nov.
Source: [RBI notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx)

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

### Muthoot Capital Services Q2: PAT ₹4.40 crore; GNPA rises to 4.81% from 3.94% in June
Muthoot Capital Services, a separate listed Muthoot Pappachan Group company (not Muthoot Fincorp, not Muthoot Finance), reported Q2 FY27 PAT of ₹440.25 lakh, against ₹282.72 lakh a year earlier and ₹812.21 lakh in Q1. GNPA including interest accrual was 4.81% of advances, against 3.94% in June and 6.46% a year earlier; its shares closed 4.28% lower at ₹195.03 on 6 Nov.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a rising NPA ratio at a group-name company may draw attention to the separation between Muthoot Pappachan Group entities as Muthoot Fincorp's NCDs list.
Source: [NSE results filing](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/debt/WDM/MUTHOOTCAPS_05112026211829_Final.pdf)

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

### ICRA assigns AA+ (Stable) to Fedbank Financial Services' NCDs
ICRA on 6 Nov assigned [ICRA]AA+ (Stable) to NCDs of Fedbank Financial Services and reaffirmed its ratings on commercial paper and subordinated debt.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: Fedbank Financial is a gold-loan competitor; its ICRA AA+ compares with Muthoot Fincorp's CRISIL AA/Stable NCD rating.
Source: [ICRA](https://www.icra.in/Rationale/ShowRationaleReport?Id=146801)

### CRISIL reaffirms IIFL Finance at AA/Stable
IIFL Finance told the exchanges on 6 Nov that CRISIL reaffirmed Crisil AA/Stable on its bank loans and NCDs, PPMLD AA/Stable on market-linked debentures, and A1+ on commercial paper.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: IIFL Finance, another gold-heavy lender, carries the same CRISIL AA/Stable rating as Muthoot Fincorp's NCDs.
Source: [NSE filing](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/IIFL_06112026183137_Intimation_CR_Crisil.pdf)

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

### TPG's Rise Funds to invest up to ₹800 crore in Kirloskar-backed Arka Fincap
Kirloskar Oil Engines disclosed a shareholders' agreement signed on 6 Nov with Arka Fincap and TPG SG Arca Pte for TPG's proposed investment. Arka says the deal is ₹525 crore initially plus a possible ₹275 crore tied to milestones and approvals; it has an AUM of about ₹8,000 crore across 146 branches.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: private-equity capital continues to flow to mid-sized secured-retail NBFCs, context for Muthoot Fincorp's proposed IPO.
Source: [NSE filing (Kirloskar Oil Engines)](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/KIRLOSENG_07112026012948_SE_Outcome_6Nov26.pdf)

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

### MobiKwik's NBFC to start lending in 3–6 months, co-lending first
MobiKwik said its new NBFC subsidiary expects to begin operations in three to six months through an asset-light co-lending model with banks and NBFCs. It aims to disburse ₹5,000 crore over three to four years in secured and unsecured consumer and MSME credit.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: another fintech becomes a regulated lender aimed at small-ticket Tier 2 and 3 borrowers, a customer base that overlaps with Muthoot Fincorp's.
Source: [NSE press release](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/MOBIKWIK_06112026144634_Press_Release_06112026.pdf)

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

### Aadhar Housing Finance: Stage 2 up 29 bps to about 3.6% in Q2
ETBFSI Research reports Aadhar Housing Finance's Stage 2 rose about 29 bps sequentially to around 3.6% in the September quarter, the second straight quarter of deterioration. Gross Stage 3 rose 4 bps to 1.35%, while credit costs eased to about 30 bps from 41 bps.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: early-bucket slippage is rising in affordable housing and LAP, segments Muthoot Fincorp's DRHP lists for growth beyond gold.
Source: [ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/aadhar-housing-finance-sees-second-straight-quarter-of-asset-quality-deterioration/135624585)

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

### Manappuram Finance's Group CTO resigns
Manappuram Finance disclosed on 7 Nov that Narayanan Easwaran, Group Chief Technology Officer and a senior management person, has resigned for personal reasons, effective close of business that day.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a technology leadership change at a Kerala-based gold-loan competitor, days before its 12 Nov Q2 earnings call.
Source: [NSE filing](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/MANAPPURAM_07112026101504_Reg_30_GCTO_Resignation_SD.pdf)

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Sunday: Weekly preview + sector health check

### The week ahead: allotment, listing, a peer earnings call and the Reg 52 deadline
Muhurat trading is today. Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I allotment and BSE listing fall on Monday and Tuesday, and Manappuram Finance holds its Q2 FY27 earnings call on Thursday 12 Nov at 5 PM IST. Listed-debt issuers' Q2 results under SEBI LODR Regulation 52 are due by 14 Nov.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: Manappuram's call comes two days before the Reg 52 deadline, so its Stage 2 and Stage 3 commentary under the April gold-loan rules is the nearest peer benchmark for Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 disclosure.
Source: [NSE — Manappuram earnings call notice](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/MANAPPURAM_05112026222522_prior_intimation_concall_SD.pdf)

### Health check: strong growth, rising early-bucket stress
The sector numbers point in two directions. Small gold lender Finkurve (Arvog) reported Q2 FY27 AUM up 95.4% YoY to ₹1,312 crore with GNPA at 2.63%. Elsewhere, Aadhar Housing's Stage 2 and Muthoot Capital Services' GNPA both rose quarter on quarter, and RBI's 6 Nov data (covered yesterday) had NBFC gold-jewellery loans up 66.1% YoY.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: fast gold-book growth across the sector, small lenders included, alongside early-stage slippage in adjacent products, is the setting for Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 results.
Source: [NSE — Finkurve press release](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/FINKURVE_05112026195145_Press_release.pdf)

# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Sunday, 8 November 2026 (IST)

---


## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

✅ No new RBI, SEBI, IBBI, NHB or FIU-IND instrument for NBFCs since Friday evening. Two items worth logging are below.

### RBI issues NBFC Certificate of Registration to MobiKwik's lending arm
One MobiKwik Systems disclosed on 6 Nov that RBI has issued a Certificate of Registration under the RBI Act to its wholly owned subsidiary, MobiKwik Financial Services Pvt Ltd, to operate as an NBFC. The company says lending will start in three to six months, first through co-lending with banks and NBFCs.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no rule change; the registration adds another regulated fintech-owned lender in small-ticket Tier 2 and 3 credit.
Reference: company disclosure under SEBI LODR Reg 30/51 (no RBI circular) · Addressed to: stock exchanges · Issued: 6 Nov 2026
Source: [NSE filing](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/MOBIKWIK_06112026141941_Intimation_about_granting_of_NBFC_License.pdf)

### Watchlist sweep: nothing new for gold-loan NBFCs on 6–7 Nov
RBI's notifications feed ends with the 5 Nov Master Directions on cyber resilience for non-bank payment system operators. Its press releases end with routine 6 Nov items: the September NBFC sectoral credit release (covered yesterday), a 4-day VRR auction for 9 Nov, a T-bill auction, the FLA census, and a Section 35A direction on one co-operative bank. Nothing on the Master Directions page has an NBFC "updated as on" date in November. SEBI's newest circular is still 5 Nov, and its 6 Nov items are the settlement-regulations commencement (covered yesterday) plus recovery and adjudication orders. The IBBI site shows a last update of 31 Oct, NHB's newest notice (4 Nov) is a broker-empanelment waiver, and FIU-IND's homepage gave no dated notice to parse.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none today. The open regulatory dates for listed-debt NBFCs remain the 21 Nov Credit Risk-o-Meter start and the 26 Nov PSL comment window.

cards.title: Muhurat trading today after the Nifty's best week in this run: +8.58%
cards.summary: NSE's circular confirms a special Diwali Muhurat session on Sunday, 8 Nov, with continuous trading from 14:20 to 15:30 IST, and every trade carries settlement obligations. The session follows a week in which the Nifty 50 rose 8.58% (23,053.10 on 30 Oct to 25,030.35 on 6 Nov) and Nifty Financial Services rose 10.41% (24,712.20 to 27,283.95), per NSE index close files.
cards.impact: the session is the last equity print before the scheduled Tranche I NCD allotment, and a financials index up 10% in a week forms the backdrop for the NCD listing and for comparisons with listed gold lenders.

cards.title: Update: Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD: allotment checkpoint is Monday
cards.summary: Nothing new since the 5 Nov close. Chittorgarh's page this morning still shows final bids of 2.67x at 17:00 IST on 5 Nov and no basis-of-allotment data.
cards.impact: the allotted size against the ₹500 crore ceiling is due to be known on Monday; the listing print on Tuesday sets the secondary-market reference for the rest of the ₹4,000 crore shelf.

cards.title: ICRA finalises Muthoot Fincorp's Delta 3.0 PTC ratings; Delta 5 gets provisional AA+(SO)
cards.summary: On 6 Nov ICRA confirmed as final its ratings on PTCs issued by Delta 3.0, backed by Muthoot Fincorp's unsecured QR code-based merchant loan receivables. On 4 Nov it assigned provisional [ICRA]AA+(SO) to PTC Series A1 and provisional [ICRA]AA-(SO) to the equity PTC of Delta 5, backed by a similar merchant-loan pool.
cards.impact: another Delta transaction extends securitisation funding for the unsecured QR merchant-loan book; the Delta 5 ratings remain provisional until confirmed.

cards.title: Week in review: gold-loan peers lead a sharp financials rally
cards.summary: From the 30 Oct close to the 6 Nov close on NSE, Muthoot Finance rose 19.11% to ₹2,869.00, IIFL Finance 18.59% to ₹625.75, Shriram Finance 16.76% to ₹961.15, Bajaj Finance 15.83% to ₹1,087.75, Muthoot Microfin 14.12% to ₹153.92 and Manappuram 12.60% to ₹325.40. All six beat the Nifty 50's 8.58% weekly gain.
cards.impact: listed gold lenders re-rated sharply in a single week despite Muthoot Finance's Q2 Stage 3 increase; peer valuations are the comparison set for Muthoot Fincorp's proposed ₹3,000 crore IPO.

cards.title: Spot gold slips 0.3% on Friday but posts its best week since August
cards.summary: Reuters, via Economic Times, reported spot gold down 0.3% at $4,074.36 an ounce at 18:54 GMT on 6 Nov after stronger-than-expected US payrolls, but up 5.2% for the week, its best week since August. Gold had touched a one-year low of $3,869.85 on 30 Oct. Source: Economic Times / Reuters
cards.impact: a 5% weekly rebound in dollar gold raises collateral values for gold lenders, though IBJA's 999 rate fell 1.86% on 6 Nov and AGLOC's 7–9 Nov ceilings reflect that lower Friday rate.

cards.title: RBI grants NBFC registration to MobiKwik's lending subsidiary
cards.summary: One MobiKwik Systems told NSE on 6 Nov that RBI has issued a Certificate of Registration to its wholly owned subsidiary MobiKwik Financial Services Pvt Ltd to operate as an NBFC. Source: NSE filing

cards.title: Muthoot Capital Services Q2: PAT ₹4.40 crore; GNPA rises to 4.81% from 3.94% in June
cards.summary: Muthoot Capital Services, a separate listed Muthoot Pappachan Group company (not Muthoot Fincorp, not Muthoot Finance), reported Q2 FY27 PAT of ₹440.25 lakh, against ₹282.72 lakh a year earlier and ₹812.21 lakh in Q1. GNPA including interest accrual was 4.81% of advances, against 3.94% in June and 6.46% a year earlier; its shares closed 4.28% lower at ₹195.03 on 6 Nov. Source: NSE results filing
cards.impact: a rising NPA ratio at a group-name company may draw attention to the separation between Muthoot Pappachan Group entities as Muthoot Fincorp's NCDs list.

cards.title: ICRA assigns AA+ (Stable) to Fedbank Financial Services' NCDs
cards.summary: ICRA on 6 Nov assigned [ICRA]AA+ (Stable) to NCDs of Fedbank Financial Services and reaffirmed its ratings on commercial paper and subordinated debt. Source: ICRA
cards.impact: Fedbank Financial is a gold-loan competitor; its ICRA AA+ compares with Muthoot Fincorp's CRISIL AA/Stable NCD rating.

cards.title: CRISIL reaffirms IIFL Finance at AA/Stable
cards.summary: IIFL Finance told the exchanges on 6 Nov that CRISIL reaffirmed Crisil AA/Stable on its bank loans and NCDs, PPMLD AA/Stable on market-linked debentures, and A1+ on commercial paper. Source: NSE filing
cards.impact: IIFL Finance, another gold-heavy lender, carries the same CRISIL AA/Stable rating as Muthoot Fincorp's NCDs.

cards.title: TPG's Rise Funds to invest up to ₹800 crore in Kirloskar-backed Arka Fincap
cards.summary: Kirloskar Oil Engines disclosed a shareholders' agreement signed on 6 Nov with Arka Fincap and TPG SG Arca Pte for TPG's proposed investment. Arka says the deal is ₹525 crore initially plus a possible ₹275 crore tied to milestones and approvals; it has an AUM of about ₹8,000 crore across 146 branches.
cards.impact: private-equity capital continues to flow to mid-sized secured-retail NBFCs, context for Muthoot Fincorp's proposed IPO.

cards.title: MobiKwik's NBFC to start lending in 3–6 months, co-lending first
cards.summary: MobiKwik said its new NBFC subsidiary expects to begin operations in three to six months through an asset-light co-lending model with banks and NBFCs. It aims to disburse ₹5,000 crore over three to four years in secured and unsecured consumer and MSME credit.
cards.impact: another fintech becomes a regulated lender aimed at small-ticket Tier 2 and 3 borrowers, a customer base that overlaps with Muthoot Fincorp's.

cards.title: Aadhar Housing Finance: Stage 2 up 29 bps to about 3.6% in Q2
cards.summary: ETBFSI Research reports Aadhar Housing Finance's Stage 2 rose about 29 bps sequentially to around 3.6% in the September quarter, the second straight quarter of deterioration. Gross Stage 3 rose 4 bps to 1.35%, while credit costs eased to about 30 bps from 41 bps.
cards.impact: early-bucket slippage is rising in affordable housing and LAP, segments Muthoot Fincorp's DRHP lists for growth beyond gold.

cards.title: Manappuram Finance's Group CTO resigns
cards.summary: Manappuram Finance disclosed on 7 Nov that Narayanan Easwaran, Group Chief Technology Officer and a senior management person, has resigned for personal reasons, effective close of business that day. Source: NSE filing
cards.impact: a technology leadership change at a Kerala-based gold-loan competitor, days before its 12 Nov Q2 earnings call.

cards.title: The week ahead: allotment, listing, a peer earnings call and the Reg 52 deadline
cards.summary: Muhurat trading is today. Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I allotment and BSE listing fall on Monday and Tuesday, and Manappuram Finance holds its Q2 FY27 earnings call on Thursday 12 Nov at 5 PM IST.
cards.impact: Manappuram's call comes two days before the Reg 52 deadline, so its Stage 2 and Stage 3 commentary under the April gold-loan rules is the nearest peer benchmark for Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 disclosure.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Sunday: Weekly preview + sector health check
cards.title: Health check: strong growth, rising early-bucket stress
cards.summary: The sector numbers point in two directions. Small gold lender Finkurve (Arvog) reported Q2 FY27 AUM up 95.4% YoY to ₹1,312 crore with GNPA at 2.63%.
cards.impact: fast gold-book growth across the sector, small lenders included, alongside early-stage slippage in adjacent products, is the setting for Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 results.

cards.summary: One MobiKwik Systems disclosed on 6 Nov that RBI has issued a Certificate of Registration under the RBI Act to its wholly owned subsidiary, MobiKwik Financial Services Pvt Ltd, to operate as an NBFC. The company says lending will start in three to six months, first through co-lending with banks and NBFCs.
cards.impact: no rule change; the registration adds another regulated fintech-owned lender in small-ticket Tier 2 and 3 credit.

cards.title: Watchlist sweep: nothing new for gold-loan NBFCs on 6–7 Nov
cards.summary: RBI's notifications feed ends with the 5 Nov Master Directions on cyber resilience for non-bank payment system operators. Its press releases end with routine 6 Nov items: the September NBFC sectoral credit release (covered yesterday), a 4-day VRR auction for 9 Nov, a T-bill auction, the FLA census, and a Section 35A direction on one co-operative bank.
cards.impact: none today. The open regulatory dates for listed-debt NBFCs remain the 21 Nov Credit Risk-o-Meter start and the 26 Nov PSL comment window.
